prompt:
Image 1 is a flat lay of a Wrestling kit, photographed from the front.

Photograph THAT SAME KIT from the BACK — the same garments, turned over:
- the shirt, laid flat and face DOWN, so its back is what you see
- the shorts below it, also turned so their back is what you see
EXACTLY ONE of each. No socks, no shoes, no ball, nothing else in the frame.

Everything carries over from image 1 unchanged: the same colours, the same fabric, the
same cut, the same collar, and above all the SAME PANELS AND
TRIM — a stripe, a panel or a piping that exists on the front continues around to the
back exactly as the garment's construction would carry it. Nothing is added that image 1
does not have, and nothing that image 1 has quietly disappears.

SLEEVES: this is the same garment as image 1, so it has exactly the same sleeves. If the
shirt in image 1 has short sleeves, this one has short sleeves and is NOT a sleeveless
vest or a tank top. If image 1 is sleeveless, this one is sleeveless. Look at image 1 and
copy what is there.

THE KIT — these are settled decisions, not suggestions. Do not substitute anything.
- shirt: A SOLID RED one-piece wrestling SINGLET — one garment covering torso and thighs together, with a deep scooped neckline and wide shoulder straps, and NO contrasting band across the chest. The club crest — the white octagon with its red border and the red-and-black hammer — sits LARGE and CENTRED on the chest. The number 1 sits on the LOWER LEG of the singlet on one thigh in WHITE with a dark navy outline, and a small white maker's mark sits on the opposite leg. The BACK of the singlet is not visible in any photograph; the DECISION is that it stays plain red with NO number and NO lettering, because a wrestling singlet carries its number on the thigh and inventing one across the shoulders would put a mark on this kit that does not exist. No club name, no player name, no sponsor.
- shorts: There is NO separate lower garment: the singlet IS the whole kit and covers the thighs. Nothing else is worn on the legs except the knee pad.
- socks: BLACK CREW-LENGTH socks that extend several inches ABOVE the collar of the wrestling shoes, with a small white maker's mark at the outer ankle — his own socks exactly as photo3.png shows them.
- footwear: His own WRESTLING SHOES exactly as photo3.png shows them: a light high-cut wrestling boot laced up over the ankle, predominantly LIGHT GREY AND WHITE with NAVY lacing and navy side panels, small RED accents, and a pale strap fastened across the instep — carrying the maker's mark it really has. A flexible flat sole; NOT sneakers, NOT cleats. Clean and new in every shot: copy what he wears, never its condition.
- equipment: BLACK wrestling HEADGEAR — ear guards over both ears held by pale grey-white straps over the crown and behind the head with a chin strap, exactly as photo2.png shows it. It covers the EARS ONLY and leaves the whole face open. A BLACK KNEE PAD with a small maker's mark on ONE knee, as the photograph shows. NO ball and NO implement of any kind — this sport has none, and nothing may be invented into his hands.
- Where an item above is described from the athlete's own photographs, any manufacturer's
  logo it genuinely carries stays on it — that is their real clothing.
- The club crest sits LARGE and CENTRED on the chest of the singlet, roughly two hand-widths across, exactly where and how large the kit photograph shows it. That position is settled and is the same in every frame.

THE BACK OF THE SHIRT carries the squad number 1, plus whatever else the
kit description above explicitly gives it — and nothing more. Add no mark the description
does not name.
NEVER any lettering: no club name, no player name, no sponsor, no word of any kind.
Nothing sits inside, on top of or overlapping the numerals — a badge, if the description
calls for one, is small, clear of the number, and the right way round.

Hard requirements:
- Everything is BRAND NEW and immaculate: no dirt, no scuffs, no wear, no sweat marks.
- Flat lay from directly overhead. No mannequin, no person, no body, no hanger, no rail.
- The same plain light grey surface and the same even lighting as image 1.
- No text of any kind beyond the number, no labels, no neck tag, no watermark.
- Sharp throughout, photographic, print quality. Square image.
